name: Incinerate
text: Incinerate deals 3 damage to any target. A creature dealt damage this way can't be regenerated this turn.
flavor: "Yes, I think 'toast' is an appropriate description."\n—Jaya Ballard, Task Mage
rulings: [{'date': '2007-07-15', 'text': 'Regeneration abilities that would affect that creature can still be activated; they just won’t do anything. The creature can’t be regenerated for any reason, even if an effect other than Incinerate would deal lethal damage to it or otherwise destroy it.'}]
